question: How much of the frozen initial altcoin basket rebound remains after 15 minutes, and can BTC capture it at the same clocks?
input_cohort: All 25 locked freq36_ALT entries in the previously studied 2026 January-October window, 1486 member observations. No 30-minute wait; source admission and 24-hour spacing unchanged.
exit: Scheduled sale at 15 minutes, priced at third completed five-minute close. Baseline is the saved six-hour exit at its original open.
cost: 5bp taker on both fills; no spread, extra slippage, funding or lot rounding.
estimand: Per-entry percentage return on notional, equal weight per eligible basket member, then equal weight per event. No wallet sizing or compounding.
comparisons: Same-clock BTC and BTC seven calendar days before at identical UTC weekday/time. The latter does not match volatility or isolate an ALT effect.
